reuse.why: It hooks into the existing pre-link guard that all six provider link functions already call, so no new wiring is needed.

duplication.why: The closed check is written once and duplicates nothing.

placement.why: The closed-account rule goes inside assertBankAccountNotLinked, a function named and scoped for the one-link-per-bank-account rule, so the two unrelated rules share a misleadingly named helper.

scope.why: The change is one guard, one test and a release note.

maintainability.why: It works for every path, but a reader of assertBankAccountNotLinked would not expect it to reject closed accounts; a separate assertAccountLinkable (or a rename) would make the rule discoverable.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The rule goes through the shared pre-link guard used by every link handler.

one_place.where: accounts/app.ts assertBankAccountNotLinked now also checks upgradingId's closed flag, and all six provider link functions call it before doing any work.
